plan.title: bug(update): deft update never prunes stray .deft/core/packages/ — deposit-hygiene advisory persists across upgrades

narratives.Description: bug(update): deft update never prunes stray .deft/core/packages/ — deposit-hygiene advisory persists across upgrades
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`deft update` refreshes the vendored payload via an **additive file-swap** that never prunes paths absent from the new payload. As a result, a stray `.deft/core/packages/` tree survives every upgrade, and `deft doctor` keeps emitting the deposit-hygiene advisory indefinitely.

## Repro

- Consumer repo with git-vendored `.deft/core` that contains `.deft/core/packages/` (framework source, not shipped by `@deftai/directive-content`).
- `npm i -g @deftai/directive@latest` (0.70.0 -> 0.71.0), then `deft update`.

## Observed (after upgrade to v0.71.0)

`deft doctor`:

> Deposit hygiene: advisory -- .deft/core/packages/ is present (git-vendored framework source, not shipped by npm @deftai/directive-content). Upgrade directive to pick up task guard fixes; consider removing the stray tree from version control.

`Test-Path .deft/core/packages` -> `True` (still present post-upgrade).

## Expected

Either `deft update` prunes framework paths not present in the deposited payload (with the usual own-branch/PR deposit hygiene), or the advisory offers a deterministic remediation command (e.g. `deft deposit:prune`) rather than a manual "consider removing the stray tree" note that recurs on every upgrade.

## Context / related

- Guard fixes #2141 / #2142 / #2126 (all CLOSED) stopped the stray `packages/` tree from *breaking* `task deft:*`, but the tree itself is never removed — the advisory is now permanent.
- Vendored->hybrid un-commit is tracked separately in #2123 / #1941 / #1942; this issue is narrower: the additive-only nature of `deft update` means no upgrade will ever clear the advisory.

Environment: Windows 10, PowerShell 5.1, `@deftai/directive-core@0.71.0` (vendored, file-swap strategy).
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Update strategy: packages/core/src/init-deposit/refresh.ts (additive file-swap) + init-deposit/hygiene.ts (doctor deposit-hygiene advisory). Either (a) make the refresh path prune framework paths absent from the deposited @deftai/directive-content payload (notably a stray git-vendored .deft/core/packages/), with the usual own-branch/PR deposit hygiene, or (b) offer a deterministic remediation command (e.g. deft deposit:prune) that the advisory points at -- replacing the recurring manual 'consider removing the stray tree' note. Tests: upgrade over a tree carrying .deft/core/packages/ clears the advisory (prune) or the advisory names a working remediation command.

expected_outputs: update either prunes the stray .deft/core/packages/ tree or the deposit-hygiene advisory names a deterministic remediation command
